summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC (issuer) filed a Form 6-K attaching a standard TR-1 notification of major holdings from BlackRock, Inc. BlackRock reported that its total holdings in Ryanair fell below the 3% threshold, crossing the notification line on 29 May 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are present. This is a routine threshold crossing disclosure under EU/UK transparency rules, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any corporate event warranting classification beyond an ordinary regulatory filing.
